marketing_description: The SATCO® Direct Wire Downlight (S11646) operates at 120 V, 60 Hz and delivers 800 lm of LED output with a CRI of 90 through a frosted polycarbonate lens, housed in a white aluminum slim‑canless fixture that includes the bulb and a remote driver. It offers selectable CCT from 2700 K to 5000 K, dimmable control, an airtight, IC‑rated design suitable for wet locations, and an edge‑lit, 108° beam for uniform illumination without a recessed housing can.
